mission: At Fidelstine Charity Concerns and Orphanage, we exist to restore dignity to the abandoned and hope to the forgotten. We provide safe shelter, nourishing care, quality education, and unwavering emotional support to orphaned and vulnerable children and adults, not as charity alone, but as a sacred responsibility. Every child who walks through our doors is met with love, protection, and the tools to build a future of their own choosing.
missionShort: We provide safe shelter, nourishing care, quality education, and unwavering emotional support to orphaned and vulnerable children and adults. Every child who walks through our doors is met with love, protection, and the tools to build a future of their own choosing.
missionMore: Through compassionate caregiving, family reunification, vocational training, empowerment, and crisis response, we stand in the gap for those society has overlooked, walking with them from vulnerability to self-sufficiency, one life at a time.
vision: We envision a world where no child grows up unseen, unheard, or unloved, where every abandoned life is given a second chance at wholeness. Fidelstine aspires to be a beacon of hope across Nigeria and beyond: a home where broken stories are rewritten, where trauma gives way to resilience, and where vulnerable children and adults are equipped not just to survive, but to thrive, lead, and give back to the communities that once overlooked them.
visionShort: A world where no child grows up unseen, unheard, or unloved. A home where broken stories are rewritten and vulnerable lives are equipped not just to survive, but to thrive, lead, and give back.

values.name: Compassion
values.text: We treat every child, the less privileged, the abandoned and vulnerable adult with tenderness, patience and empathy, seeing beyond circumstance to the person within.

values.name: Dignity
values.text: We uphold the worth of every individual in our care, ensuring they are never defined by their past, but empowered by their potential.

values.name: Integrity
values.text: We operate with transparency and accountability in all we do, honouring the trust placed in us by donors, partners and communities.

values.name: Resilience
values.text: We equip those we serve with the emotional strength, education and life skills to rise above trauma and build independent lives.

values.name: Training and Empowerment
values.text: We give young people and vulnerable adults practical skills, vocational training and mentoring, so they can earn a living, lead, and stand on their own.

values.name: Community
values.text: Healing happens in relationship: family reunification, local partnerships and a sense of belonging for every child.

values.name: Advocacy
values.text: We speak up for the rights of the vulnerable, working to influence policy and practice that protects those who cannot protect themselves.

programmes.title: Safe Shelter & Family Care
programmes.summary: A safe, loving home with meals, care and the steady adults every child deserves.
programmes.body: Children who come to us find a safe bed, regular meals and caring adults who know them by name. Our caregivers look after their health, schooling and emotional wellbeing, and wherever it is safe, we work to trace and reunite children with their families.
provides: Safe beds and a secure home

programmes.title: Education & Vocational Training
programmes.summary: School fees, books, tutoring and practical skills that open doors to independence.
programmes.body: We keep children in school by paying fees and providing uniforms, books and supplies, with tutoring after classes. Older young people and vulnerable adults learn practical, income-earning skills, and we mentor them as they take their first steps into work.

programmes.title: Crisis Response
programmes.summary: Emergency food, clothing, medical care and shelter when disaster strikes.
programmes.body: When families are hit by flooding, illness or sudden hardship, we step in with food, clothing, medicine and somewhere safe to stay. We then follow up, so the help leads to recovery and not just a single day of relief.

christmas.headline: The Christmas Scheme is open
christmas.intro: Each December we bring Christmas to children and families who would otherwise go without: food, new clothing, a gift for every child and a Christmas meal we share together. Every gift, however small, helps us reach one more family this year.

items.name: Volunteer

items.name: Supporter

items.title: Where it began
items.text: Fidelstine started with a simple conviction: no child in our community should grow up unseen, unheard or unloved.

items.title: The home opens
items.text: A safe home opened in Ubulu Okiti, giving children a bed, regular meals and caring adults around them.

items.title: Education programme
items.text: School sponsorships began, followed by tutoring and skills training for older young people and vulnerable adults.

items.title: The Christmas Scheme
items.text: The first seasonal outreach brought food, clothing and gifts to families across the community. It now runs every year.

items.title: Growing together
items.text: With an extension site, new school uniforms and more children in class, the work keeps growing, and so does our need for partners.

steps.title: A good start
steps.text: The day begins with breakfast, morning devotion and the rush to get uniforms on and school bags packed.

steps.title: Learning
steps.text: The children spend the day at school, while older young people attend skills classes and training.

steps.title: Play and friendship
steps.text: After lunch and homework help, there is time for games, football and friends.

steps.title: Family time
steps.text: Dinner together, evening devotion and bedtime in a safe, quiet home.

faqs.q: How can I give right now?
faqs.a: By bank transfer to our GTBank account in Nigeria, or through PayPal from anywhere in the world. The details are at the top of this page. Online card payments are coming soon.

faqs.q: Which currencies can I give in?
faqs.a: By bank transfer, we have GTBank accounts in naira, pounds, US dollars and euros, so you can send in your own currency. With PayPal you can send almost any currency.

faqs.q: How will I know my gift arrived?
faqs.a: Send us a WhatsApp message or use the contact form after you give. We will confirm your gift and thank you personally.
Yes. Just don't include your name, or tell us you'd like to stay anonymous. We never publish donors' names without permission.
Yes. Payments are handled by Flutterwave, a licensed payment company. Your card or bank details never touch our website.

faqs.q: Which currencies can I give in?
faqs.a: Naira, pounds, dollars, euros and several African currencies. Choose yours at the top of the form.
Card, bank transfer, USSD and, in some countries, mobile money. The options depend on your currency.
